title: Tactical Arena
tagline: 30 units, campaign battles, online duels, every tile a gamble.
description: A browser-based isometric tactics game on a fantasy war-table — the successor to Mini-Tactics. Draft four-unit squads from a 30-unit roster with ARTS abilities, passives, statuses, summons, weather, and terrain. Play the 22-mission campaign, five tutorials, local hot-seat 2-4 player matches, single-player vs CPU, casual online Quick Match/private rooms (Classic 1v1, Draft 1v1, 4 Player FFA, 2v2 Teams), or a signed-in server-authoritative Ranked 1v1 queue with ELO — plus a Valor/shop progression loop for unit and skin unlocks.
status: Release candidate — campaign, tutorials, local/CPU play, Online Versus, Ranked 1v1, Valor progression, skins, and shop
